body:
chris.user: Hey — trying to redeem promo TRIAL-2026 during signup, UI says "Promo code invalid or expired". Account: chris@acme.com, org org_abc123. Signed up via an invite link earlier today. Any idea?

sam_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact code and confirm whether you used the web UI or our API? Screenshot helps too. :slightly_smiling_face:

chris.user: Code is exactly TRIAL-2026. Tried web UI (Chrome incognito) and the API via the dashboard 'Apply code' flow. Screenshot attached.

promo-bot: promo-service log: redeem_attempt code=TRIAL-2026 org=org_abc123 result=code_not_active reason=external_id_mismatch

sam_support: thanks. I see a bot trace showing external_id_mismatch. @anya_billing can you check whether the promo is active and if there was any recent migration for that code?

anya_billing: looking now — TRIAL-2026 is active in the promo DB and shows remaining_redemptions=1. It is assigned to grant: credits=3000, expires=2027-03-01. But it is linked to legacy_user_id=usr_legacy_897, which got merged into primary_user_id=usr_342 after invite-merge on 2026-12-30. The redemption flow validates the external_id against the promo owner, and the merge changed the external id mapping.

sam_support: ok — that explains the external_id_mismatch. We can manually grant the credit to your org while we fix the service validation. Would you like us to proceed?

chris.user: yes please, would appreciate the manual grant. Also happy to help with logs if needed.

sam_support: @anya_billing can you create a manual credit for org_abc123 (3000 credits) and mark it as replacement for TRIAL-2026? Also add a note so finance doesnt double-charge.

anya_billing: done — manual credit applied: tx=credit_789xyz amount=3000 note="Manual grant for TRIAL-2026 due to external_id merge". Email confirmation sent to chris@acme.com.

chris.user: got it, credits showed up in dashboard. thanks! :tada:

dev_oncall: root cause summary for engineering: reconciliation/validation in promo-service requires promo.owner_external_id == request.external_id. During invite-based signup we recently switched to using primary_email_normalized for external_id; legacy promos used legacy_user_id. When accounts were merged the mapping wasn't consulted and validation failed. Repro steps: 1) create promo tied to legacy_user_id, 2) merge legacy_user_id into primary_user_id, 3) attempt redeem using primary_user external_id => failure.

dev_oncall: quick mitigation pushed to canary: match by owner_user_id OR by owner_legacy_id mapping from user-mapping table. Patch: https://git.internal/redwood/promo-service/pull/1123. Will promote to prod after 1h smoke.

sam_support: thanks. @chris.user we'll keep this thread updated if the patch triggers any reprocessing for other affected promo codes. For now the manual grant is in place and your org can use the credits. Closing ticket after your confirmation.

chris.user: confirmed credits are usable. appreciate the quick help.

promo-bot: automation-note: scheduled job 'promo-reconcile' will re-run for recently-merged accounts at 2027-01-13T02:00Z to correct any stale links.

sam_support: marking resolved. If anything else pops up ping us or reopen the ticket. :thumbsup:
